text.arabic_uthmani: أَمْرًۭا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ

words.gloss_range: an accusative command-matter or decree-affair that continues the prior separated-affair frame and is then specified by provenance
words.root_gloss_range: root range around commanding, ordering, affairs, authority, and execution; locally the verbal noun holds command and matter together rather than selecting only one English branch

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following source phrase that authenticates the command-matter by provenance
the closing sender-state that turns sourced command into dispatch

words.prose: {{ar:أَمْرًۭا}} ({{tr:amran}}) opens 44:5 as an accusative continuation rather than a fresh independent sentence. It reaches back to the separated wise affair in 44:4, then waits for {{ar:مِّنْ عِندِنَآ}} ({{tr:min ʿindinā}}) to mark its provenance. The verbal noun keeps command, decree, and handled affair compressed into one unit: the reader hears not only an order, but the ordered matter being sourced for dispatch. Its indefiniteness leaves the command-matter broad until the source phrase narrows it, and even its nasal ending flows into the following source phrase rather than letting the noun hang loose after the boundary. The later {{ar:كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ}} ({{tr:kunnā mursilīna}}) shifts that sourced matter toward standing sender-agency rather than instant coming-to-be.

topics.headline: accusative continuation from the prior decree
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah boundary remains syntactically porous: the opening command-matter completes the decree-separation of 44:4 before the new assertion begins.
topics.reason: The QAC row marks an accusative verbal noun with possible specifying or circumstantial force, and attachment support warns against isolating {{ar:أَمْرًۭا}} ({{tr:amran}}) from the prior decree frame; the supplied variant contrast is therefore kept only as secondary pressure, not as an independent local parse.

topics.headline: command and affair held together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word does double work: it is directive speech and the ordered affair that the directive brings into view.
topics.reason: The local verbal noun and source phrase preserve both command and affair pressure; the missing V4 root rows for this root do not block a coherent CRITICAL lexical claim.

topics.headline: indefinite verbal noun before provenance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the staged movement from an open, object-like command-matter to a command-matter restricted by origin.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative and indefinite, and the following governed source phrase supplies provenance after the noun has first been heard broadly.

topics.headline: command is carried into being-state and sending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command-matter is not sealed inside decision; it is backed by enduring agency and carried toward dispatch.
topics.reason: The local sequence moves from {{ar:أَمْرًۭا}} ({{tr:amran}}) to the state-and-sending predicate, while the 36:82 comparison is kept as a contrast between instant coming-to-be and the sustained sender-state in 44:5.

topics.headline: sound binds the noun to provenance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sound transition helps the opening noun move into the source particle rather than remain detached.
topics.reason: The rows describe a local sound hinge between the indefinite ending and the following source particle; this supports the same provenance movement already forced grammatically.

words.gloss_range: source-preposition marking origin or provenance for the following speaker-bound locus

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the command-matter whose provenance is being marked

words.prose: {{ar:مِّنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) is the short hinge that turns the opening command-matter into provenance. It governs {{ar:عِندِنَآ}} ({{tr:ʿindinā}}), so the phrase does not merely say that the command is with the speaker; it says that the command issues from the speaker's domain. Its nasal shape also carries into the governed source word, making the small particle sound attached to its object rather than independent. Because this source phrase comes before {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}), the ayah authenticates origin before it explicitly asserts sender identity. The particle has no lexical root here, and its source sense is the active value, not a partitive reading.

topics.headline: particle selects provenance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that provenance, not mere location or partitive selection, is the relation that organizes the phrase.
topics.reason: The preposition governs {{ar:عِندِنَآ}} ({{tr:ʿindinā}}), and attachment evidence identifies the phrase as the source of {{ar:أَمْرًۭا}} ({{tr:amran}}).

topics.headline: origin is established before agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the order of disclosure: the command is sourced before the speaker steps forward as sender.
topics.reason: The source phrase stands between the command noun and the emphatic sender clause, making the particle a structural pivot.

topics.headline: sound binds particle to its object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the small source particle is heard as attached to its governed source-locus rather than as a loose connector.
topics.reason: The local rows press the audible binding of the particle to the following word, and that binding matches the syntactic governance.

words.gloss_range: speaker-bound source-locus: the command's provenance as possessed presence, custody, and authority rather than bare spatial location
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes proximity, presence, possession, evaluative nearness, and contrastive deviation or resistance; locally the governed construct selects source-presence and authority

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the source preposition governing the locus
the following speaker assertion and state frame

words.prose: {{ar:عِندِنَآ}} ({{tr:ʿindinā}}) names the source as a possessed speaker-domain. Because {{ar:مِّنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) governs it, the word functions as provenance for the command-matter, not as an unanchored adverb. Its construct form makes the source definite and speaker-bound before {{ar:إِنَّا كُنَّا}} ({{tr:innā kunnā}}) turns that source into explicit agency. In the same line, the source-locus is tied to command-matter, being-state, and dispatch rather than remaining static possession. The repeated speaker cadence moves from possessed source into emphatic identity and established state. The local sense is proximity, presence, and custody; the resistance branch of the root remains only a contrastive edge, sharpening how different source-nearness is from turning aside.

topics.headline: governed locus of provenance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sourcehood is grammatically explicit: the command is traced from a locus, not merely described as near the speaker.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:عِندِنَآ}} ({{tr:ʿindinā}}) as governed by the source particle and as specifying the source of {{ar:أَمْرًۭا}} ({{tr:amran}}).

topics.headline: construct form binds source to speaker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source is not abstract origin; it is a definite domain already bound to the speaker inside the word.
topics.reason: The construct form with first-person plural suffix is syntactically forced and continues the speaker role active in the discourse.

topics.headline: presence becomes custody and authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that nearness is not bare space: the command comes from held authority, while the root's resistance branch supplies only contrastive background.
topics.reason: V4 supports both proximity/presence and deviation/resistance branches; local grammar selects the governed source-presence branch, so resistance survives only as contrastive pressure.

topics.headline: source-locus joins command, state, and sending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source-locus does not remain static; it is joined to command, being-state, and dispatch in the same line.
topics.reason: The local phrase is tied to {{ar:أَمْرًۭا}} ({{tr:amran}}), followed by {{ar:كُنَّا}} ({{tr:kunnā}}), and resolved by {{ar:مُرْسِلِينَ}} ({{tr:mursilīna}}); the 19:64 comparison is a contrast between authorization by command and the local source-location of command.

topics.headline: source phrase closes first beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source phrase bridges nominal command and verbal sender assertion rather than belonging wholly to either side.
topics.reason: The word closes the first phrase before the emphatic clause begins, so it mediates between sourced command-matter and sender identity.

topics.headline: speaker-centered sound chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a local sound progression from possessed source to emphatic identity to established state.
topics.reason: The repeated first-person plural endings make the speaker-chain audible while the grammar carries that same speaker into the following clause.

words.gloss_range: emphatic first-person plural particle-pronoun that turns provenance into asserted sender identity

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the preceding source word whose speaker suffix is resumed
the predicate content governed by the emphatic clause

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}) is the pivot where sourced provenance becomes direct assertion. The particle does not merely intensify a later verb; it fuses emphasis with first-person plural speaker identity and governs the whole sender predicate, {{ar:كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ}} ({{tr:kunnā mursilīna}}). After {{ar:عِندِنَآ}} ({{tr:ʿindinā}}), the same speaker who possessed the source now speaks as guarantor of sending. The dense sound of the doubled consonant reinforces the grammatical compression of assertion and identity.

topics.headline: emphatic speaker governs the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sending claim is not impersonal; it is guaranteed by an emphatically named speaker.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify an emphatic annulling particle fused with a first-person plural pronoun and governing the following predicate clause.

topics.headline: source becomes speaking agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the turn from sourced command to the source speaking as sender.
topics.reason: The word follows the source phrase and opens an emphatic clause whose predicate is the established sending role.

topics.headline: speaker echo compresses assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sound and form make the same speaker present in possession, assertion, and the coming state clause.
topics.reason: The surface form fuses particle and pronoun, and the repeated speaker morphology links it back to {{ar:عِندِنَآ}} ({{tr:ʿindinā}}).

words.gloss_range: perfect copular auxiliary marking an established speaker-state whose predicate is ongoing sending
words.root_gloss_range: root range around being, occurring, becoming, and temporal predication; locally the perfect copular frame selects established state rather than instant creation or independent event

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the emphatic speaker frame whose predicate this verb supports
the active participial predicate selected by the copula
the command-matter backed by the established sender-state

words.prose: {{ar:كُنَّا}} ({{tr:kunnā}}) is the hinge that makes sending a state rather than a one-time event report. It takes {{ar:مُرْسِلِينَ}} ({{tr:mursilīna}}) as predicate, so the speaker's agency is expressed through being established as senders. Its first-person plural ending completes the chain from source possession to assertion to state, locking the sender role to the same speaker. The repeated nasal syllables slow the line around that speaker-state before the longer final participle releases it. The perfect form gives the current sourced command historical continuity: the ayah does not only say that dispatch happens now, but that dispatch belongs to the speaker's standing mode of action. Against the command-to-being formula in 36:82, 44:5 uses the same root field differently, with being-state supporting sender identity. The same root frame later contrasts with human disputing in 44:50.

topics.headline: copula makes sending an established state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sending is predicated as an established speaker-state, not narrated as a single completed dispatch.
topics.reason: The verb is a perfect copular auxiliary with {{ar:مُرْسِلِينَ}} ({{tr:mursilīna}}) as predicate, selecting temporal predication and established state from the root range.

topics.headline: agreement keeps the sender role with the speaker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same speaker morphology moves from source possession to assertion to state, locking the sender role to that speaker.
topics.reason: The verb carries first-person plural agreement and governs a plural predicate, while the discourse evidence keeps the same speaker active.

topics.headline: being root contrasts instant creation and disputing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root's wider creation and state field helps distinguish 44:5's enduring sender-state from instant coming-to-be in 36:82 and from disputed human state in 44:50.
topics.reason: The wider root range supports contrast, but local grammar selects the copular state with a participial predicate rather than importing an instant creation formula.

topics.headline: state language backs command and dispatch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that command, being-state, and sending explain one another inside the line: sourced decree rests on standing agency.
topics.reason: The local construction joins {{ar:أَمْرًۭا}} ({{tr:amran}}), {{ar:كُنَّا}} ({{tr:kunnā}}), and {{ar:مُرْسِلِينَ}} ({{tr:mursilīna}}) into one source-to-agency movement.

topics.headline: cadence weights the state before closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the line slow around the speaker-state before it releases into the final sending predicate.
topics.reason: The sound observation reinforces the grammatical movement from emphatic assertion through temporalized state into the final predicate.

words.gloss_range: Form IV active participial predicate naming ongoing dispatching agency, object-open and final in the ayah
words.root_gloss_range: root range around sending forth, release, messenger and message, dispatch, succession, ease, and related movement; locally Form IV selects active dispatching agency while object omission leaves the sent item open

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the emphatic state frame governing the final predicate
the sourced command-matter that the final sender role explains
the emphatic speaker frame governing the final predicate
the copular state verb that governs the final participle
the source phrase converted into outward transmission

words.prose: {{ar:مُرْسِلِينَ}} ({{tr:mursilīna}}) is the ayah's final landing: the sourced command is explained by the speaker's identity as senders. Its accusative plural participial form depends on {{ar:كُنَّا}} ({{tr:kunnā}}) under {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}), so the word is not an ungoverned title. Because no object is supplied, the sending field remains open to command, message, or envoy, while Form IV keeps the speaker as dispatcher. The uncommon active-participle role becomes more salient because it stands last and supplies the terminal long cadence. That close stretches the earlier speaker-marking sounds into a final plural agentive predicate. The release image of the root turns {{ar:مِّنْ عِندِنَآ}} ({{tr:min ʿindinā}}) from held source into outward transmission. Compared with object-marked messenger sending in 14:4, 44:5 abstracts the role; later messenger language in 44:13 and 44:17 can then appear within the same sender-and-sent field.

topics.headline: final predicate names sender identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word is the guaranteed predicate of the emphatic state clause, not a loose description after the command.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:مُرْسِلِينَ}} ({{tr:mursilīna}}) as the accusative predicate governed by {{ar:كُنَّا}} ({{tr:kunnā}}) inside the emphatic clause.

topics.headline: objectless sending keeps dispatch open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the predicate names a standing dispatching role while leaving the sent object unstated, so command, message, and envoy remain in play without being collapsed into one.
topics.reason: The local Form IV active participle selects dispatching agency, while the omitted object preserves openness; broader release and successive-sending pressures survive only as support for sustained outward dispatch.

topics.headline: rare participle seals the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the uncommon active-participle role is made more salient by final position and terminal cadence.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the exact active-participle form as low-count, and the word's final position lets its long closing cadence carry semantic closure.

topics.headline: source-to-dispatch thread extends outward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from sourced command to sender role, with 14:4 highlighting the contrast between object-marked messenger sending and 44:5's objectless dispatch identity, and 44:13 and 44:17 continuing the messenger field.
topics.reason: The local line pairs command, source, being-state, and sending, while the supplied references provide concrete contrast and same-surah continuation without controlling the local parse.

topics.headline: speaker cadence releases into agent role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sound arc move from repeated speaker marking into the final plural agentive predicate.
topics.reason: The cadence rows align with the syntactic movement from emphatic speaker identity through state into the final sending predicate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain `amran min indina ... kunna mursilin` joins a payload, its point of origin, and an established sending subject.
baseline_models.mechanism: A matter that can also function as a directive originates in the speaker's presence and is released outward; `kunna` presents sending as an established mode rather than an isolated act.

activation_trace.role: The matter-or-affair image supplies the content that is to pass from source to destination.
The command-or-directive image makes the payload operative rather than merely informational.
The proximity-and-presence image locates the matter at an authoritative source before its outward movement.
The being-and-temporal-predication image turns sending into a standing temporal disposition.
The release-and-dispatch image supplies the outward vector that carries the sourced matter.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified command comes from the speaker, who sends.
changed_reading.after: An operative matter moves from the speaker's own presence into history through an established practice of release and dispatch.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The singular `amran` stands beside the durative-looking `kunna mursilin`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The one matter can be heard as one installment within repeated dispatches: the sender persists while payloads or carriers proceed successively.

activation_trace.role: The individual affair image lets this matter function as one unit in a larger series.
Temporal predication supplies continuity to the sender across more than the immediate event.
The successive-batches image organizes sending as repeated units moving one after another.

changed_reading.before: This verse reports one sending event.
changed_reading.after: This matter is one packet in a continuing, serial economy of dispatch.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `Amran` can activate an appointed sign or time, while `mursilin` supplies emission from `indina`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The matter is not only an instruction but a marked release point: a signal held at the source becomes effective when sent into its appointed interval.

activation_trace.role: The mark-or-appointed-time image gives the matter the function of a scheduled signal.
Presence-at-the-source supplies the signal's point of custody before release.
Temporal occurrence lets the marked matter become active within time.
Release and dispatch convert the held appointment into an emitted event.

changed_reading.before: A directive is sent from the speaker.
changed_reading.after: A source-held appointment or signal is released into its effective time.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Authority in `amr`, responsibility in `kawn`, and messenger/message in `mursilin` can align as a commission.
baseline_models.mechanism: An authority-originating mandate is placed under responsibility and borne as a commission by an envoy; this coexists with the simpler temporal use of `kunna`.

activation_trace.role: The authority-and-command-holder image supplies the mandate's governing source.
The presence image marks direct provenance rather than anonymous transmission.
The suretyship image supplies entrusted responsibility, though it is form-distant from the auxiliary here.
The messenger-and-message image supplies the bearer and the carried commission together.

changed_reading.after: A mandate with direct provenance is entrusted to a responsible bearer as an authorized commission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent sequence makes the focus matter the output of a pipeline: an ordinance is fixed, brought down, differentiated from a whole into distinct matters, perfected, and then dispatched from the source.

activation_trace.role: The directive image supplies an executable payload for the contextual production sequence.
Dispatch supplies the final outward stage after differentiation.
The fixing-that-entails-judgment image gives the pipeline a determinate written or decreed input.
The causing-to-descend-and-arrive image supplies transfer from source into the receiving domain.
The discrimination image supplies controlled differentiation rather than undirected scattering.
The encompassing-whole image supplies the total field from which each matter is distinguished.
The affair image explicitly links the differentiated contextual units to the focus payload.
The perfected-and-secured image makes each separated matter a finished, stable unit.

structural_cues: The focus `amran` immediately follows `yufraqu kullu amrin hakim`, allowing it to resume or specify the differentiated matter.
The order book, descent, differentiation, source, and sending supports a directional process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixing, descent, differentiation, totality, perfected matters, and dispatch; I supply the arrow that treats them as successive processing stages. A live alternative is that they are parallel descriptions of one revelation rather than a production pipeline.

changed_reading.before: A command is sent from the speaker.
changed_reading.after: A fixed ordinance is brought down, resolved into perfected executable matters, and released outward from its source.

activation_trace.role: The growth-and-blessing image turns the matter into something generative rather than merely coercive.

changed_reading.before: The focus transmits an authoritative directive.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Directive released from presence into history.** `ء م ر B002` supplies command, `ع ن د B004` proximity/presence, and `ر س ل B001` being sent forth and released. The movement is explicitly from “with Us” to sending; I infer a directional transfer from authoritative presence into the created sequence. The command reads as a dispatched operative force, not inert information.
2. **Sending in successive installments.** `ر س ل B005` supplies succession in batches. Against the singular `أمرًا` and the continuing `كنا مرسلين`, I infer that one articulated command belongs to a repeated sending practice. The ayah can therefore hold together a concentrated decree and serial historical delivery.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 44:23-24 supplies a concrete dispatched command whose execution moves servants and leaves the sea in a specified state. The later tactical sequence makes “command from Our presence” read more operationally than the opening alone suggested.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The command is a timed signal.** `ء م ر` `B002` is directive, while `B005` is a mark, agreed signal, or appointed time. The blessed night (`44:3`), differentiated affairs (`44:4`), and the coming `يَوْمَ` watched for (`44:10`) create a temporal sequence around this command. Its assigned role is both instruction and trigger. The packet supplies the temporal markers; I infer **appointed signal -> onset of dispatched action**. `أَمْرًا` now reads as an activating marker, not only propositional content.

2. **Sending is staged release.** `ر س ل` `B001` is release or dispatch, `B004` is deliberate pace, and `B005` is succession in batches. Those branches are activated by the prior ordering and division (`44:3-4`) and by the later life/death polarity (`44:8`). The senders’ role is to carry apportioned command in controlled succession. The packet supplies ordering, dispatch, and later effects; the inferred arrow is **ordered batches -> effects arriving at their proper stage**. The participle `مُرْسِلِينَ` consequently suggests sustained administration rather than one isolated sending.

3. **Source proximity resists remoteness.** `ع ن د` `B004` denotes proximity and presence. It is bracketed by “from Us” here and “from your Lord” in the mercy statement (`44:6`), before lordship expands across heavens, earth, and their interval (`44:7`). The branch makes source-presence the guarantor of the command despite its cosmic range. I infer **proximate source -> undiluted authority across distance**. The ayah’s `مِّنْ عِندِنَا` becomes an operational claim of immediate provenance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The bounded `مِيقَات` of `44:40` confirmed the command’s timed-signal branch, while `44:58` showed dispatch reaching its audience through eased language. Sending therefore proved to include both execution in appointed time and communicative arrival in a fitted form.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, yol veya amaçlanan doğrultudan yana sapmayı, bir topluluktan ayrı bir yanda durmayı ve çeşitli varlıkların ortak yönden ayrılmasını açıkça bir araya getirir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu uzamsal ayrılma çekirdeğini doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki ayrılma karşı koyma niyetini gerektirmez; yön, yer ve topluluğa katılma bakımından yana çıkmayı anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yan ve taraf bildiren bağımsız biçimi; yoldan sapma, sürüden ayrı durma ve ortak yönden çıkma bildiren belirli kuruluşlarla karıştırmadan kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Bir yolun, amaçlanan doğrultunun ya da topluluğun ortak çizgisinden yana ayrılmak ve ayrı bir tarafta durmak; yan bildiren ad ile canlıların, yolun ve bir okun bu ayrılığı gösteren özel kullanımlarını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir varlık izlenen yoldan veya ortak doğrultudan yana sapar.
Bir kişi ya da deve topluluğa karışmayıp ayrı bir yanda durur.
Bir bağımsız biçim doğrudan yan veya taraf anlamı taşır.
Yolun eğik uzanması, saplama vuruşunun sağa sola gitmesi ve bir okun ötekilerden başka yönde çıkması bu ayrılmanın özel örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleşen kanıt, ortak yol veya topluluktan yana ayrılma çekirdeğini; yan adı, ayrı duran insan ve deve, eğik yol ve başka yönde çıkan ok gibi somut gerçekleşmelerle gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü kanın yana akmasını veya dinmeden fışkırmasını ve kusmanın art arda sürmesini açıkça destekler. Bol yağmurlu bulut da aynı dalda tanıklanır, ancak bu son kullanım doğrudan bir akış sürecini değil, bulutun yağmur bolluğunu niteler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca sıvının akması değildir; kuruluşlara bağlı olarak yana yönelme, kesilmeme veya art arda gelme koşulu taşır, bulut niteliği ise uzantıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca verilen kan, damar, yara, kusma ve yağmur bulutu kuruluşlarına bağlanır; bunlardan bağımsız genel bir akma anlamı çıkarılmaz.

Bir bulut bol miktarda yağmur taşır veya yağdırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca yakınlık bildiren görevli birimin yer, zaman, değerlendirme ve değer kullanımlarını kapsar; kökün bağımsız bir eylem anlamı olarak genellenmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü süt için kullanır, bol ve art arda meme akışını bu adlandırmanın gerekçesi olarak verir ve bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde etmesini aynı dala bağlar. Çerçeve madde, akış ve elde edilebilirlik ayrımlarını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sütü, özellikle bol ve sürekli gelen sütü kapsar; sürü, ileti veya genel bolluk anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım süt çekirdeğini korur; sütün bolluğu ile bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde eder hale gelmesi ayrı sözcük kullanımları olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Hayvandan elde edilen süt, özellikle memeden bol ve art arda gelen süt; ayrıca bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde eder duruma gelmesidir.

facets.statement: Dalın somut çekirdeği hayvandan elde edilen süttür.
Sütün bol olması ve memeden kesintisiz ya da art arda gelmesi özellikle vurgulanabilir.
Topluluğa uygulanan kullanım, hayvanlarının süt vermesi sayesinde süt sahibi duruma gelmelerini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sözcüğü süt için verir; bolluk ve memeden sürekli geliş niteliğini belirtir, ayrıca hayvanlarından süt elde etmeye başlayan topluluğu aynı anlam alanına bağlar.

error_profile.preserves: Sütü, bolluğunu ve sürekli akışını korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde eder duruma gelmesi uzantısını doğrudan adlandırmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kişinin iç dünyasının birine veya bir şeye yönelmesini; yabancılık duygusunun kalkıp güven, rahatlık ve açıklık doğmasını anlatır. Çerçeve bu iç yöneliş ile dışa açılma sonucunu doğru bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi karşılıklı haberleşmeyi, atışma gibi bir uğraşta kişinin yanında duran eşliği ve şarkı ya da işte öncekinin ardından gitmeyi aynı karşılıklılık ve izleme alanında toplar. Çerçeve bu özel katılımcı rollerini doğru korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kayıt genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, içindeki öğeler birbirinin yerine geçen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtın verdiği adlandırma sınırı içinde kullanılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim, adlandırma veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal ortak bir anlam çekirdeği göstermeyen altı ayrı adlandırmayı bir arada tutmaktadır; kısa ok, iki damar, damızlık erkek deve, aktarım zinciri kopuk söz, boncuklu kolye ve başını örtmeyen küçük kız ayrı ayrı ele alınmalıdır.

facets.statement: Dalın tek ortak özelliği, ortak anlamı bulunmayan özel adlandırmaların geçici olarak aynı yapısal kapta toplanmış olmasıdır.
Bir kullanım birlikte anılan iki damarı adlandırır.

Bir kullanım henüz başını örtmeyen küçük kızı niteler.
Bir kullanım kısa bir ok türünü adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.
